missions.title: Departure Day
missions.description: The joint operation with the military has officially started. While the Commander is waiting for his first order, something happens…

missions.title: Toward the Frontlines
missions.description: We linked up with M4A1 and came under Sangvis attack. The Commander is too far away to assist us, so we can only ask the military for help.

missions.title: Into the Hinterland
missions.description: AR Team reassembles and charges with us to the frontline. We are now pushing toward the core stronghold of Sangvis Ferri!

missions.title: Cleanup
missions.description: The next task is to protect the military's anti-jammer equipment. This task is tough, but M4A1 has a bold proposal.

missions.title: On the Run
missions.description: The military is pushing too quickly and we can't keep up with the rearguard formation, but M4A1 comes up with another plan. The new M4A1 seems to be much more proactive than before.

missions.title: Desperate Breakout
missions.description: Due to miscommunications with military intelligence (I don't know why), AR Team finds themselves in grave danger. The Commander is on the way with reinforcements. Just hold on!

missions.title: Betrayal I
missions.description: AR Team is fighting desperately to resist the Sangvis forces while the Commander is trying to break the encirclement from the outside. I hope everything will be alright…

missions.title: Betrayal II
missions.description: What is the situation with M4A1? The Commander and I are both very worried. Does RO know of a way to restore her…?

missions.title: Betrayal III
missions.description: The military forces have finally shown up. Although we still can't establish comms with them, they should be able to join the fray very soon. We are very close to rescuing AR Team!

missions.title: Betrayal IV
missions.description: Hey! Hey! What is going on?! Everything is a mess! What happened to AR Team? What about our base? What should I do, Commander?!

missions.title: The Battlefield without Her I
missions.description: I won't give up on any opportunity... I shall think of a way to repel S.F. and become Griffin's new star!

missions.title: The Battlefield without Her II
missions.description: Can't believe Fräulein Kar wants me to wait here at the lookout like an idiot. Intel collection is my forte. I must find information about Sangvis Ferri.

missions.title: The Battlefield without Her III
missions.description: Is Sangvis Ferri...actually this powerful? N-nein, there's still hope... If I we use THAT... I shall have both victory and credit, and I won't let either go.

missions.title: The Battlefield without Her IV
missions.description: Credit or whatever doesn't matter anymore. What matters is we won this battle...! Though...I hope someone will remember my contribution after I'm reactivated...
